difficulty_reason: After characteristic-zero symmetric-group representation theory and standard FI-module representation stability, the authored proof still establishes the stable induced-orbit structure of finitely generated FI-sets and its compatibility with fixed isotypic projection maps. It then reduces relation coefficients to fixed-intersection fibers and proves their eventual zero-or-binomial behavior using finite generation. The stable-orbit construction and projection/fiber analysis form the retained non-routine obligation beyond standard qualification exercises.
